claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission of NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch four astronauts around the Moon in early 2026.
Artemis II is the first human lunar flight in over 50 years.
Artemis II will test life support systems for future lunar landings.
NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is 322 feet tall.
NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket generates 8.8 million pounds of thrust.
